comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Regression: partner reports that option ids passed as numbers still get dropped after coercion — array of numbers fails the string[] guard. Reopening until we coerce numeric ids or document string-only.

content.text: Regression: partner reports that option ids passed as numbers still get dropped after coercion — array of numbers fails the string[] guard. Reopening until we coerce numeric ids or document string-only.

SDK createIssue drops values for multi-select custom fields. The field is present in the request object, but the serialized payload either omits it or sends an empty array, so the issue is created without those selections.

Expected: multi-select custom fields accept an array of option ids and persist them on create. Actual: the v2 serializer treats multi-select like single-select and takes only a string path; arrays fail the type guard and the field is stripped before the HTTP send.

Hypothesis: CustomFieldValue union in the SDK still models multi-select as string rather than string[], a leftover from when the API only allowed single values. Server API has accepted arrays since 2.2.
Migration scripts and intake forms that set multi-select metadata create incomplete issues and require manual edits.
